projects.name: field-ops-sql-cost-audit
projects.description: A dbt and SQL analytics project that reconciles messy field-operations data into a cost-to-serve per job and route, and shows where SLA breaches concentrate. Recursive route sequencing, utilization windows and cost allocation are modeled once, under test.
highlights: Layered dbt pipeline (staging, business logic, reporting views) over dispatch, route, timesheet and fuel tables.
Tableau cost-to-serve explorer and SLA-breach heatmap by region and time of day.
dbt tests and a GitHub Actions gate on every push; runs fully offline on DuckDB.

projects.name: retail-margin-cockpit
projects.description: A governed margin and inventory source of truth for small and mid-size retail teams: a tested dbt star schema, a DAX measure library and a Power BI semantic model with row-level security.
highlights: 56+ dbt tests (not_null, unique, relationships, accepted_values) across the star schema.
Regional Manager and HQ Analyst row-level-security roles, plus a Postgres RLS demo.
Surfaced Footwear gross margin at 42.4% against a 49.9% blended average.

projects.name: lakehouse-quality-gate
projects.description: An active data-quality gate for a dbt and Iceberg lakehouse. A Great Expectations checkpoint sits between the intermediate layer and the marts, blocks the pipeline on bad data and sends a webhook alert naming the failing expectations.
highlights: Four failure modes tested: null floods, duplicate keys, negative values and schema drift.
Failed checks stop the marts from being built and send an alert with sample offending row IDs.

projects.name: elt-pipeline-dbt-snowflake-airflow
projects.description: An ELT pipeline that extracts data from Reddit, OpenWeather and a PostgreSQL SaaS database, loads it into Snowflake and transforms it with dbt, with testing, documentation and lineage. Airflow runs the daily refresh.
highlights: Three source systems loaded into Snowflake raw schemas.
dbt staging, intermediate and mart layers with not_null, unique, accepted_values and freshness checks.
GitHub Actions CI and Slack alerting on failures.

projects.name: healthcare-analytics
projects.description: MedInsight, a patient analytics dashboard that scores readmission risk before discharge, with risk stratification, population health cohort analysis and explainable predictions.
highlights: Random Forest readmission model reported at 85.2% accuracy and 0.89 AUC-ROC.
SHAP explainability and cohort analysis for risk-factor identification.
Role-based access control and audit logging.

projects.name: weather-data-pipeline-great-expectations
projects.description: A weather pipeline that collects hourly observations for 50+ global cities from the Open-Meteo API, validates each batch with Great Expectations and transforms it with dbt into analytics-ready BigQuery tables.
highlights: Quality checks cover schema, null rates, value ranges, row counts and freshness; failures halt the pipeline and alert Slack.
21 unit tests across 5 suites.
Incremental dbt marts for daily weather and 30-day city climate summaries.

projects.name: multi-source-marketing-analytics
projects.description: A marketing analytics pipeline that streams CRM and e-commerce database changes through Debezium and Kafka, adds ad-platform REST data, and models a Customer 360 view in Snowflake with dbt.
highlights: CDC from PostgreSQL and MySQL plus Google Analytics, Google Ads and Facebook Ads sources.
dbt star schema with SCD Type 2 snapshots and a dim_customer_360 model.
14 unit tests passing across 3 suites.

projects.name: ecommerce-lakehouse-medallion
projects.description: An e-commerce lakehouse built on a Bronze, Silver and Gold medallion architecture with Delta Lake, SCD Type 2 tracking and a Gold star schema for BI, plus dbt models for the Silver-to-Gold step.
highlights: Bronze raw ingestion, Silver cleaning and deduplication, Gold facts and dimensions.
Customer value segmentation and RFM scoring in the Gold layer.
8 unit tests passing across 2 suites.

projects.name: enhanced-anomaly-detection-system
projects.description: A deep-learning anomaly detection system for cloud network traffic that trains and compares LSTM, CNN and autoencoder models on the CSE-CIC-IDS2018 and MAWIFlow 2025 datasets.
highlights: Multi-dataset training with feature engineering and weighted sampling for class balance.
Side-by-side evaluation of accuracy, precision, recall and F1 across three model architectures.
